success_criterion: binary success from registered condition sets (e.g. GraspedCondition + DetectedCondition by a proximity sensor)
human_data: none (demonstrations from motion planning on authored waypoints, not human data)
paper_code_mismatch: Paper states a purely sparse +1 reward; the maintained repo (since 2022) ships opt-in dense shaping (negative L2 distance terms) for at least three tasks (reach_target, take_lid_off_saucepan, slide_block_to_target), off by default. Paper claims 100 tasks; the repo file tree at this commit has 107 .ttm task files.
note_gaps: The underlying physics engine (Bullet/ODE/Vortex/Newton) and simulation timestep are not stated in either source; no FPS/throughput numbers are reported anywhere.
